title: Fix chat PRD review popup overflow and scrolling across device sizes
specification:
# PRD: Fix chat PRD review popup overflow and scrolling across device sizes

Priority: high

## Problem
The chat PRD review popup can exceed the viewport on some devices, making the modal non-scrollable and hiding the submit button unless the user zooms out.

## Goal
Make the chat PRD review popup fully usable on mobile, tablet, and desktop without zooming, with accessible scrolling and a consistently reachable submit action.

## Requirements
- Update the control-plane chat PRD review modal layout to fit within the viewport on small and medium screens.
- Ensure the modal has a bounded height with an internal scrollable content region when proposal content is long.
- Keep the primary submit action visible and reachable on all supported device sizes.
- Add responsive spacing and sizing rules for the modal shell, card, header, content, and footer controls.
- Preserve existing chat PRD review functionality and submission flow.

## Acceptance Criteria
- On narrow mobile screens, the PRD review popup stays within the viewport and the user can scroll the review content without browser zoom.
- The submit button is reachable and usable on iPhone-sized, Android-sized, tablet, and desktop viewports.
- Long PRD proposals do not push modal controls off-screen.
- Opening, closing, backing out, and submitting the chat PRD review still work as before.

## Verification
- Inspect and update the modal styles and markup in `src/server/control-plane/control-plane-page.tsx`.
- Test the PRD review popup at representative viewport sizes such as 320x568, 390x844, 768x1024, and desktop widths.
- Verify keyboard and pointer access to Close, Back to chat, and Submit actions after the responsive changes.
